ja450:1.1: Apacantāpi dicchanti santo laddhāna bhojanaṃ, kim eva tvaṃ pacamāno yaṃ na dajjā na taṃ samaṃ.
ja450:2.1: Maccherā ca pamādā ca evaṃ dānaṃ na diyyati, (cfr. Feer, Saṃyutta- I p. sq.) puññaṃ ākaṃkhamānena deyyaṃ hoti vijānatā ti.
ja450:3.1: [Yass' eva bhīto na dadāti maccharī tad eva adadato bhayaṃ] dighacchā ca pipāsā ca yassa bhāyati maccharī tam eva bālaṃ phusati asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
ja450:4.1: Tasmā vineyya maccheraṃ dajjā dānaṃ malābhibhū, puññāni paralokasmiṃ patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan ti.
ja450:5.1: Duddadaṃ dadamānānaṃ dukkaraṃ kamma kubbataṃ asanto nānukubbanti, sataṃ dhammo durannayo.
ja450:6.1: Tasmā satañ ca asatañ ca nānā hoti itogati: (II | 1.) asanto nirayaṃ yanti, santo saggaparāyanā ti.
ja450:7.1: Appasm' eke pavecchanti, bahunā eke na dicchare, appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā sahassena samaṃ mitā ti.
ja450:8.1: Dhammaṃ care yo pi samuñchakaṃ care dārañ ca posaṃ dadaṃ appakasmi pi, sataṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ kalaṃ pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti.
ja450:9.1: Ken' esa yañño vipulo mahagghato samena dinnassa na aggham eti, kathaṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti.
ja450:10.1: Dadanti h' eke visame niviṭṭhā jhatvā vadhitvā atha socayitvā, sā dakkhiṇā assumukhā sadaṇḍā samena dinnassa na aggham eti, evaṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti.
